checks.note: Healthy-rest gate; not a patient-specific reference interval.

checks.note: Direction anchored to human regional-perfusion HPV evidence (Asadi et al.); exact PaO2 gain is model-specific.

checks.note: Direction anchored to human hypoxic exposure/transplant-lung data; v0.14 does not fit an individual PAP time course.

checks.note: Qualitative/scale gate anchored to Crotti et al.; thresholds are not patient-specific CT estimates.

checks.name: recruitment state evolves dynamically after pressure change
HPV/recruitment stress preserves chemistry and finite dynamics

credibility_classification.HPV: regional reduced precapillary resistance controller driven by alveolar PO2; human mechanism anchored, molecular signaling omitted
credibility_classification.regional_perfusion: parallel conductance redistribution with whole-lung equivalent resistance coupled to the closed-loop pulmonary circulation
credibility_classification.recruitment: six-unit pressure-threshold model with opening/closing hysteresis and finite time constants; not CT-personalized
credibility_classification.PEEP: recruitment-state input only; not a complete mechanical ventilator or heart-lung interaction model

remaining_limitations: no continuous MIGET inversion or patient-specific regional V/Q distribution
no pleural-pressure/gravity field or spatial lung geometry
no dynamic lung/chest-wall compliance curve coupled to airway pressure and work of breathing
no full PEEP effect on venous return, RV afterload and overdistension
no surfactant kinetics or alveolar surface-tension model
no molecular HPV signaling, endothelial modulation or disease-specific HPV impairment
next_high_value_step: v0.15 should add lung/chest-wall mechanics with pressure-volume hysteresis, overdistension and PEEP-heart interactions, then calibrate recruitment and V/Q outputs against CT/EIT/MIGET data before disease models.
